sentence_stem: If only I had studied harder,
correct_completion: I would have passed the exam.
full_sentence: If only I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: I would have done better on the test.
I would have gotten a higher grade.

options.why_wrong: This states a past fact, not a wish. 'If only' expresses regret about something that did not happen.
This talks about the future. 'If only' with the past perfect expresses regret about the past.

options.text: I would have passed the exam.

options.why_wrong: This describes a present habit and does not express a wish about the past.

grammar_focus: Wishes about the past with 'if only' + past perfect
explanation: 'If only' expresses a regret about the past. Use the past perfect after it, and 'would have' plus the past participle in the main clause. Learners whose first language has a simpler past tense system often need extra practice with this pattern.
translation: Ojalá hubiera estudiado más, habría aprobado el examen.
